violations.text: Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch prior to use. Ice was voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Proof of ice machine sanitation to be sent to inspector. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment to use all disposable single service ware until dishmachine is properly adjusted. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the 3 bay sink and areas surrounding have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/25/2026

-Water was not dispensable at handwashing sink and 3 bay sink at the bar. -Hot water was not available for 3 bay sink in the back kitchen area. Water to be available for proper sanitation. Staff to wash hands at hand sink in kitchen. Proof of repairs to be sent to inspector. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
The doors to the toilet room are not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils ice machine were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was turned off and put out of service at the time of inspection. Ice machine is not to be used until it is cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/13/2025

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment is not to use dishwasher until it is able to reach the proper chlorine sanitizer concentration. Establishment is using single service cups until the dishwasher is serviced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/13/2025
Establishment is lacking drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 01/14/2025
